name: v0.6.1
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: reduce memory use when indexing Svelte projects by @eseliger in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/526
* chore(deps): group non-major Renovate updates into one PR by @christoph-sg in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/528
* chore(deps): bump brace-expansion from 5.0.9 to 5.0.12 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/524
* fix: don't resolve symbol names to paths outside the project root by @christoph-sg in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/529
* fix: look past a package.json without a name when resolving the package by @Mohith26 in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/527
* Release v0.6.1. by @eseliger in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/530

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/524
* @Mohith26 made their first contribution in https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/pull/527

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip-typescript/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1
